spans.s: भ-गण m. 1. the whole multitude of stars; 2. revolution of the planets in the zodiac; 3. the zodiac.
भा-गण m. the whole collection of stars.
भ-गोल m. the starry sphere.
भग (I) m. 1. the sun, one of the twelve suns; 2. the moon; 3. a form of Śiva.

भग (II) m.n. 1. Good fortune, happiness, prosperity, भगं ते वरुणो राजा भगं सूर्यो बृहस्पतिः । भगमिंद्रश्च वायुश्च भगं सप्तर्षयो ददुः Yaj.i.282; 2. loveliness; 3. excellence, distinction; 4. desire, love; 5. amorous sport, dalliance; 6. pudendum muliebre, Yaj.iii.88; 7. effort, exertion; 8. fame, glory; 9. absence of passion, tranquility; 10. strength, vigour; 11. omnipotence; 12. virtue, moral, merit; 13. final emancipation.

भाग m. 1. Partition, distribution; 2. a part, a share, a division, R.v.9, x.45, M.ix.131; 3. a fraction, a part of any whole; 4. a quarter; 5. the numerator of a fraction (in math.); 6. the thirtieth part of a zodical sign; 7. the 360th part of the circumference of a circle; 8. the quotient (in math.); 9. place, spot, region; 10. room, R.xviii.47.
भग-अंकुर m. the clitoris.
भग-आधान a. bestowing matrimonial felicity.
भग-घ्न m. an epithet of Śiva.
भगंदर m. a fistula in the pudendum or anus.
भग-देव m. a libertine.
भग-देवता f. a hymeneal divinity.
भग-दैवत n. the constellation Pūrvaphālgunī.
भग-नंदन m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
भग-भक्षक m. a procurer, a pander.

भग-वत् (I) a. a glorious, illustrious, excellent, venerable, revered, divine (as an epithet applied to gods, demigods, holy personages, or great men), अये वृद्धशाकल्य किमनुतिष्ठति भगवान्मरीचः Sak.vii., R.i.71, viii.81.
भग-वत् (II) m. 1. a deity, a god; 2. an epithet of Viṣṇu; 3. of Śiva; 4. Jina.
भगवदीय m. A worshipper of Viṣṇu.
भगाल n. A skull.
भगालिन् m. An epithet of Śiva.
भगिन् a. (f. नी) 1. Prosperous, fortunate; 2. grand, splendid.

भागिन् a. (f. नी) 1. One who shares; 2. sharing in, partaking of; 3. concerned in; 4. one to whom a share is due, entitled to a share, M.ix.165; 5. possessor, owner, M.ix.53; 6. consisting of parts or shares; 7. lucky, fortunate.
भगिन् a. (f. नी) 1. Prosperous, fortunate; 2. grand, splendid.
भगिनी f. 1. A sister; 2. a lucky woman; 3. a woman in general.

भागिन् a. (f. नी) 1. One who shares; 2. sharing in, partaking of; 3. concerned in; 4. one to whom a share is due, entitled to a share, M.ix.165; 5. possessor, owner, M.ix.53; 6. consisting of parts or shares; 7. lucky, fortunate.
भगिनिका f. A sister.
भगिनी-पति, -भर्तृ m. a sister’s husband.
भगिनी-पति, -भर्तृ m. a sister’s husband.
भगिनीय m. A sister’s son.
भगीरथ m. Name of an ancient king of the solar dynasty who is said to have brought down the Ganges from heaven to the earth.
भगीरथ-प्रयत्न m. a term for any Herculean exertion.
भगीरथ-सुता f. an epithet of the Ganges.
भग्न (I) a. (f. ग्ना) 1. Broken, shattered, broken to pieces; 2. routed, defeated; 3. destroyed, demolished; 4. suspended, checked, (pp. of भंज् q.v.).
भग्न (II) n. Fracture of the leg.
भग्न (I) a. (f. ग्ना) 1. Broken, shattered, broken to pieces; 2. routed, defeated; 3. destroyed, demolished; 4. suspended, checked, (pp. of भंज् q.v.).
भग्न-आपद् f. one who has overcome misfortune.
भग्न-आश a. disappointed.
भग्न-उत्साह a. broken in energy, discouraged.
भग्न-उद्यम a. baffled, frustrated.
भग्न-क्रम n. violation of grammatical construction, considered as a fault of composition. See प्रक्रमभंग.
भग्न-चेष्ट a. disappointed, defeated.
भग्न-दर्प a. crest-fallen, humbled.
भग्न-पार्श्व a. suffering from pain in the sides.
भग्न-पृष्ठ a. 1. having a broken back; 2. coming in front.
भग्न-प्रक्रम m. See प्रक्रमभंग.
भग्न-मनस् a. discouraged, disappointed, broken-hearted.
भग्न-संकल्प a. one whose plans are frustrated.
भग्नी f. A sister.
भाग-अर्ह a. entitled to a share.
भाग-कल्पना f. the allotment of shares.
भाग-जाति f. reduction of the fractions to a common denominator (in math.).
भाग-धेय (I) n. 1. a share, नीवारभागधेयोचितैर्मृगैः R.i.50; 2. destiny, luck; 3. good luck, तद्भागधेयं परमं पशूनाम् Bhartr.ii.12; 4. property.
भाग-धेय (II) m. 1. a tax; 2. an heir.
भाग-भाज् a. interested, sharer.
भाग-भुज् m. a king, a sovereign.
भाग-लक्षणा f. the secondary use of a word in which part of the primary meaning is retained (it is otherwise called जहदजहल्लक्षणा).
भाग-शस् ind. in parts or portions.
भाग-हर m. 1. a co-heir; 2. division (in math.).
भाग-हार m. division (in math.)
भागवत (I) a. (f. ती) 1. Relating to or worshipping Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa; 2. holy, sacred.
भागवत (II) m. A devotee of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa.
भागवत (III) n. Name of one of the eighteen Purāṇas.
भागवत (I) a. (f. ती) 1. Relating to or worshipping Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa; 2. holy, sacred.
भागिक a. (f. का) 1. Relating to a part; 2. forming one part; 3. fractional; 4. bearing interest.(भागिकं शतम् one part in a hundred, i.e. one per cent.)
भागिक a. (f. का) 1. Relating to a part; 2. forming one part; 3. fractional; 4. bearing interest.(भागिकं शतम् one part in a hundred, i.e. one per cent.)
भागिनेय m. A sister’s son.
भागिनेयी f. A sisters daughter.
भागीरथी f. 1. Name of the Ganges, भागीरथीरतपोवनानि R.xiv.28; 2. name of one of the three main branches of the Ganges.
भाग्य n. 1. Fortune, luck, destiny, भाग्यक्रमेण हि धनानि भवंति यांति Mrich.i., R.viii.47; 2. good luck, good fortune, R.iii.13, xix.24; 3. happiness, welfare.
भाग्य-आयत्त a. dependant on fate.
भाग्य-उदय m. rising prosperity.
भाग्य-योग m. the accession of good luck or fortune.
भाग्य-वत् a. 1. fortunate; 2. prosperous.
भाग्य-वशात् ind. through the will of fate, through fortune.
